newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch checks reveal no further madcow cases.
newsitem.headline: Dutch checks reveal no further madcow cases.

text.p: The relatives and stable mates of the Netherlands' first, and so far only, case of mad cow disease have been given a clean bill of health, the Dutch ministry of agriculture said on Wednesday.
Research conducted on the slaughtered cows suggests the Netherlands' first BSE (Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy) case, discovered last month, may have been an isolated one.
Results of tests on a cow born at the same time and on the same farm as Anja-3, the infected cow, have not yet emerged.
The ministry added there is no evidence to suggest BSE may have spread by the transportation of cattle, but research continues into this.
